lastCompletedStory.title: Emit CAM_ISSUE_RESULT machine line on cam issue --file-local (all outcomes)

nextStoryContext: US-002 (regression-lock cam issue list as CAM_ISSUE_RESULT-free by design) is next. The --file-local retrofit is done: dispatchIssue's file-local branch now owns the CAM_ISSUE_RESULT machine-line convention itself, mirroring close/abandon (index.ts ~1496-1552). Two new injectable seams were added to IssueDispatchDeps: createLocalIssueOnMainFn (fine-grained fake for the createLocalIssueOnMain call) and readStdinFn (fine-grained stdin fake); the pre-existing whole-branch fileLocalFn override still takes priority when present so the old US-003 branch-isolation tests stay green unchanged. New tests live in the 'dispatchIssue: default file-local CAM_ISSUE_RESULT retrofit' describe block at the end of test/issue-dispatch.test.ts. `cam issue list` (mode:'list') already routes to issueListFn and was NOT touched by this story; US-002 should confirm/regression-lock that runIssueList never emits a CAM_ISSUE_RESULT line (list is a read-only backlog print, not a mutation outcome).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure CLI-dispatch retrofit (stdout convention + injectable seams); no external library API surface touched (Bun.stdin.text and JSON.parse are runtime builtins already validated in prior stories).
